Plays motion artwork from your chosen provider on the small lock-screen cover, large cover, and supported full-screen background. Bridge itself does not go online or download video; matching and downloading happen in the provider.

Enable the source in the provider settings first. If local album tags differ from Apple Music, bind the album manually in Dynamic Artwork Provider.
Keep the screen on while the motion cover plays

Keeps the screen on only while a motion cover is actually playing on the large cover. Pausing, pressing the power button to go to sleep or AOD, unlocking, or returning to the small lyric cover releases it, and the normal screen timeout applies again. Independent of “Keep screen on while lyrics are shown”: the screen stays on while either applies.

Changes apply immediately, are stored in Bridge, come back after a SystemUI restart, and are part of the Bridge configuration backup. ColorOS 17 support is being tested; unsupported layouts keep the official static cover.

The title, artist, album and duration of the playing song are sent to the selected provider, which matches and downloads the motion cover. Lyrics, accounts, device identifiers and the player\'s media IDs are never sent.
